name: MKT_IMP_CAMP_TEAM
description: This interface table stores staging data for marketing campaign team.  The staging data gets populated into MKT_CM_CAMP_RESOURCES and MKT_CM_CAMP_RESOURCE_TEAMS table.  The marketing campaign team is composed of resources and resource teams which have different levels of access to the campaign.

columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.description: Primary Key. Batch Identifier. Identifier that groups data into a batch.

columns.name: INTERFACE_ROW_ID
columns.description: Primary Key. Interface Row Id. Will be used to link this row with rows in the error table.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: IMPORT_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the status of the record to be processed.

columns.name: ERROR_MESSAGE
columns.description: Import error message.

columns.name: FILE_RECORD_NUM
columns.description: Record indicator in the File.

columns.name: ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the operation to be performed on a row, such as Insert, Update etc.

columns.name: RESOURCE_ORIG_SYS
columns.description: Resource  Original System .Stores a unique identifier denoting the source system

columns.name: RESOURCE_ORIG_SYS_REF
columns.description: Resource  Original System Reference. Stores the unique identifier of the campaign resource  in the source system.

columns.name: CAMPAIGN_EXT_REF
columns.description: Campaign  Original System Reference. Stores the unique identifier of the campaign  in the source system. Used to look up campaign_id

columns.name: RESOURCE_TEAM_ORIG_SYS_REF
columns.description: Resource team Original System Reference. Stores the unique identifier of the  resource team  in the source system.

columns.name: CAMPAIGN_RESOURCE_ID
columns.description: Fusion id of the campaign-resource association in MKT_CM_CAMP_RESOURCES

columns.name: CAMPAIGN_ID
columns.description: Fusion id of the campaign in MKT_CM_CAMPAIGNS

columns.name: RESOURCE_ID
columns.description: Fusion id of the campaign resource in TCA resource schema.

columns.name: ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE
columns.description: Access Level Code indicating the type of access the resource/resource team has to the campaign e.g Edit or Full.

columns.name: OWNER_FLAG
columns.description: Owner Flag indicating if this resource is the owner of the campaign.

columns.name: CAMPAIGN_RESOURCE_TEAM_ID
columns.description: Fusion id of the campaign-resource association in MKT_CM_CAMP_RESOURCE_TEAMS

columns.name: RESOURCE_TEAM_ID
columns.description: Fusion id of the resource team in TCA resource team schema

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.
